mapper.select: SELECT u.id AS userId, u.tenant_id AS tenantId, u.company_id AS companyId, o.org_path AS orgPath, t.timezone AS timezone, u.enabled AS userEnabled, t.enabled AS tenantEnabled FROM iam_user u JOIN iam_tenant t ON t.id = u.tenant_id JOIN iam_org o ON o.id = u.org_id AND o.tenant_id = u.tenant_id WHERE t.code = #{tenantCode} AND u.username = #{username}

SELECT u.id AS userId, u.tenant_id AS tenantId, u.company_id AS companyId, o.org_path AS orgPath, t.timezone AS timezone, u.enabled AS userEnabled, t.enabled AS tenantEnabled FROM iam_user u JOIN iam_tenant t ON t.id = u.tenant_id JOIN iam_org o ON o.id = u.org_id AND o.tenant_id = u.tenant_id WHERE t.oidc_issuer = #{issuer} AND t.oidc_owner = #{owner} AND u.external_id = #{subject}

SELECT DISTINCT rp.permission FROM iam_user_role ur JOIN iam_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.tenant_id = ur.tenant_id JOIN iam_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id = r.id AND rp.tenant_id = r.tenant_id WHERE ur.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.enabled = TRUE
